description: Fork of exp029 (MultiBit K=4, halved tph and output_nap) with two init-scale changes informed by exp018's converged values: (1) learnable_attn_scale_init 0.25 → 0.4 (median final value across exp018's 6 layers was ~0.4; reduces ramp-up time on the learnable scalar), (2) pos_emb_init_scale 0.1 → 0.02 (matches vanilla transformer init; prevents pos from dominating token identity in the sum-mode mix). Tests whether better init-conditioning compounds with K=4 precision trade.
